subject: Recap + ask: Q3 rollout window & approval gate
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Morales <kevin@luminahealth.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + ask: Q3 rollout window & approval gate

Hi Kevin / Sara —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so the team is aligned and we have clear next steps heading into quarter planning: 

- Primary objective: pilot Redwood inference for customer-facing triage & summarization by Q3 (pilot scope = 5 endpoints, 2M tokens/month estimate).
- Success criteria: average generation latency < 300ms p50, 99% uptime during business hours, and a 20% reduction in manual triage time.
- Security: Lumina requires SOC2 evidence + VPC option for PHI-adjacent workloads.
- Procurement / approvals: Kevin mentioned an internal architecture review + budget sign-off by the Ops committee.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a one-page POC scope and MVP requirements for your internal stakeholders (Redwood_POC_scope_v1.pdf, Lumina_MVP_requirements.xlsx).
2) Can you confirm the target pilot start window? We had discussed late Sept / early Oct to align with your Q3 launch calendar.
3) Please share the expected approval gate date for budget/PO — we can align priority in our capacity if you confirm a committed date.

If helpful, Neha (cc'd) can join the architecture call to walk through the VPC + SOC2 checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Kevin Morales <kevin@luminahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: Q3 rollout window & approval gate

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap and the docs. Quick answers:
- Pilot window: late Sept still looks feasible, but I need to confirm with Ops (they're offsite next week).
- Approval gate: aiming for an Ops committee decision the week of Aug 25; that is the current internal target.
- SOC2 / VPC: good — our security lead wants the SOC2 report and an architecture diagram for the VPC connection.

I'll try to get a calendar placeholder for a tech sync with your infra lead. If anything changes on timing I will let you know.

Best,
Kevin
Senior PM, Product Ops | Lumina Health
kevin@luminahealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Morales <kevin@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-04T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Checking in on Ops committee date / any questions on attachments

Kevin —

Following up on my note — any update from Ops on the committee week (Aug 25)? If that date holds, we can reserve dedicated infra capacity and pre-stage the SOC2 evidence & connection guide so your security review is quick.

Couple of things we can do to speed approval:
- Share a concise SOC2 summary + redacted report as an interim artifact (we can provide within 24 hours).
- Schedule a 30-minute design review between your security lead and our infra architect (Neha) to walk the VPC diagram.
- If budget approval timing is tight, we can propose a capped pilot commitment that converts after Ops sign-off.

No pressure — just trying to align our delivery plan with your internal cadence.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Morales <kevin@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-05T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Quick check before Q3 planning closes — priority/approval still on track?

Hi Kevin —

We're closing the book on our Q3 capacity planning this week and I wanted to do one final check: is Lumina still planning to move forward with the pilot in the late-Sept window and is the Ops committee sign-off (week of Aug 25) still the expected approval gate?

If priorities have shifted or the timeline is slipping, please tell us — we can:
- Pause pre-provisioning (no commitment) and re-open when you have a firm sign-off, or
- Hold a small reserved slot for you if you confirm the Aug 25 gate by EOD Fri (we'll keep the slot for two weeks), or
- Offer a short onboarding credit to accelerate the security review + first-week throughput if the committee needs an incentive to move sooner.

If I don't hear back by Friday end of day, I'll assume the decision is pending and will check back after the committee. Appreciate a quick note either way so we can plan capacity and pricing for the quarter.

Thanks —
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
